retrievalProfile.description: A deconstructed portrait using geometric shapes and photographic fragments over a technical grid background.

recipe.visualDefinition: A complex visual composition featuring a human face reassembled from disparate photographic cutouts, overlaid with bold geometric shapes like triangles and squares, all set against a fine technical graph paper grid with vibrant primary color accents.
coreVisualRelationships: Photographic fragments nested within geometric containers
Organic facial features contrasted against rigid grid lines
Primary color blocks balancing high-contrast black and white imagery
Layered depth created through overlapping paper-edge textures
Hand-drawn script juxtaposed with industrial sans-serif type
coreInvariants: Technical graph paper or grid background texture
Deconstructed facial features (eyes, lips, nose) as separate elements
High-contrast photographic grain and halftone patterns
Use of primary red, blue, and yellow as structural accents

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: A large, fragmented face occupies the central and left portions of the frame, scaled to dominate the composition.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central blue triangle containing a nose fragment acts as the geometric focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye moves from the large eye fragment at the top left, down through the central triangle, to the lips and hand at the bottom, then up to the top-right typography.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The right side and background utilize the grid pattern as active negative space to prevent visual clutter.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Off-white and cream tones from the grid and paper textures.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep blacks and high-contrast shadows within the photographic fragments.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Vibrant primary red, cyan blue, and yellow-orange used for shapes and text.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High-value background with high-saturation geometric overlays and low-value photographic shadows.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to primary colors plus black, white, and neutral paper tones.

letterConstructionRules: Tight letter spacing for the main title
Integration of symbols (like exclamation points) into the wordmark
characterSpecificRedesigns: The letter 'I' replaced or modified with an exclamation point symbol

composition.relationshipToImage: integrated into the lower collage cluster

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Industrial geometric sans-serif for the primary name paired with a loose, expressive hand-written script for the title.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the geometric skeleton and heavy weight of the top text.
Provides the 80s geometric aesthetic and wide proportions.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a collage of a deconstructed face using high-contrast black and white photographic fragments (eyes, lips, nose) and bold primary-colored geometric shapes (blue triangle, yellow square) over a light cream graph paper grid background.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply a heavy, uppercase geometric sans-serif font in primary red and blue across the top edge. Add a hand-written black script title at a slight angle in the bottom right corner over three horizontal color bars.

verificationChecks: Ensure the grid background is visible and consistent.
Check that photographic elements have a high-contrast, grainy texture.
Verify that the primary colors are vibrant and flat.
Confirm the script text is legible but looks hand-drawn.

mustRedesign: Do not replicate existing brand logos
Ensure all text is original and not copied from the source
postGenerationChecks: Is the composition deconstructed rather than a whole face?
Does the grid background feel like technical paper?
Are the colors limited to a primary palette?
Is there a clear contrast between the industrial type and the script?
Do the photographic elements show visible grain or halftone?
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine [Technical Grid] + [High-Contrast Photo Fragments] + [Primary Geometric Shapes] + [Heavy Geometric Sans-Serif] + [Hand-drawn Script] to create a post-modern collage aesthetic.
